invocation.command:
grep -rn "\.unwrap()\|\.expect(" src --include="*.rs" | grep -v "tests/\|#[cfg(test)]" | awk -F: '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 30; echo ===NONTEST_UNWRAPS===; grep -rn "\.unwrap()\|\.expect(" src --include="*.rs" | grep -v "_test\|test" | head -n 5
# better: list unwraps in non-test code by filtering files then manual check
echo ===; grep -rn "unwrap\|expect\|panic" src --include="*.rs" -l | head -n 40
